text_block_list.text: On the way home from the Japan Cup, the usually quiet Mihono Bourbon suddenly spoke up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master,
I request to enter larger races.
choice_data_list: What's with you all of a sudden?
What's the matter all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Shockingly enough, it's for emotional reasons.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I have learned all kinds of emotions through the Twinkle Series, but—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Today's sensation in particular was the deepest and sharpest of all.

Mihono Bourbon closed her eyes,
as if reminiscing about the scene.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A warm sensation welling up from deep within,
an exhilarating rush, and—perhaps—'pride.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I suspect this is strongly due to that grand stage
and the battle against a formidable opponent like Teio-san.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the more you run in races against stronger Umamusume,
every single "emotion"—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, on the contrary, I believe there is even
more to be gained from racing.

Though she seemed bewildered,
there was a hint of certainty in the way she spoke.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That makes me—'happy.'
Therefore, I desire to run
in even bigger races.

For better or worse, Mihono Bourbon is an Umamusume
who rarely asserts herself.

Aside from her long-cherished dream of the Classic Triple Crown,
she basically entered races whenever she was ordered to.

She thought it through herself and clearly stated,
'This is the kind of race I want to run in!'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Master? Please respond.
choice_data_list: Next time, let's enter an even bigger race!

text_block_list.text: With those words, Mihono Bourbon gave a happy nod.

When I returned to the academy,
Rice Shower was waiting in front of the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Miss Bourbon...!
Um, great work in the Japan Cup...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Actually... when I heard you were racing against Teio-san,
I was cheering for you in the stands.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Thank you very much.
I feel 'happy.'

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No... Rice should be thanking you.
Watching your race gave Rice so much strength.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Besides, watching her race made me feel like Bourbon-san has changed somehow...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am aware of that as well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, so that's how it is, huh...? Somehow... that makes me really happy."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, and you see...
—And Rice Shower showed a serious expression.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice wasn't just waiting around today.
You see... Rice is actually
thinking of running in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's a really huge race,
and McQueen-san and Teio-san are running too...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So, um... if it's okay with you, would you
run against Rice again there...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice wants to race Bourbon-san again,
as the Bourbon-san of today, and the Rice of today...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: No, not just Bourbon-san...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to race Teio-san, McQueen-san, and
everyone else on the big stage once more...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I just know
it's going to be a super exciting race...!

She looked so radiant,
as if her timid, hesitant self
had completely vanished into thin air.

Through the Twinkle Series,
Rice Shower seems to have grown considerably.
And Mihono Bourbon, too—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen, Tokai Teio, and Rice Shower...!

Her eyes gleamed fiercely,
as if thrilled by the future that awaited her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, I will run in the Arima Kinen.

Our next race has been set for the Arima Kinen,
a GⅠ packed with formidable rivals!
